Merged to development as e6ec219. Review rejected v1 for the exact failure the guard exists to prevent: its at-rule check covered only the 17 semantic names, so a brand file regenerated with @media (prefers-color-scheme: light) redefined the primitives underneath and the guard certified agreement in green. v2 parses a real block tree and watches the transitive closure of every primitive a mapped token resolves through, computed from the file. Because the brand file is absent from CI, fresh clones and every worktree, a resolved palette snapshot is checked in and asserted against lib/tokens.ts everywhere, plus a separate AA assertion proven load-bearing (all three files agreeing on a sub-AA value still fails).

Merged to development as b5b7d8c. Review rejected the first attempt: it routed the fix through component state, and refresh() at confirm-to-summary unmounted the recorder on EVERY match, so videoId, the chip and any failure were destroyed regardless of upload timing. The shipped fix keys the upload outcome on matchId in a module-scope store written with no mounted guard, so it survives a provider remount, a step transition, and an upload completing after the recorder is gone. Verified robust rather than layered: deleting the accompanying revalidating predicate leaves all five regression tests green, and all five are proven red against the pre-fix commit. maxDuration is now derived from the retry constants (1214s for a 600s match) with those constants moved beside it. NOT VERIFIED ON HARDWARE: the simulator has no camera.
